title: Ankhorage Neptune Graph Persistence Adapter
summary: Provides an Amazon Neptune Database Bolt adapter for the published @ankhorage/graph persistence port.
purpose: Keep Amazon Neptune Database transport, IAM authentication, and persistence mapping separate from provider-neutral graph contracts and application code.
responsibilities: Implement the published @ankhorage/graph/persistence port through Amazon Neptune Database Bolt sessions.
Own Neptune Database IAM authentication, TLS, transaction lifecycle, and provider data mapping.
boundaries: Does not support Neptune Analytics, HTTP openCypher batching, Gremlin, RDF, or SPARQL.
Does not own provider-neutral graph contracts, generic graph algorithms, or application workflows.
audience: Maintainers evaluating or implementing an Amazon Neptune persistence adapter.

architecture.role: Provider adapter package with a single Neptune Database Bolt transport behind the published graph persistence port.
invariants: Neptune-specific code remains at an adapter boundary behind the published provider-neutral graph port.
Every mutation batch is an explicit Bolt transaction and never a collection of independent HTTPS requests.
IAM credentials and SigV4 tokens are never logged or exposed from adapter errors.

limitations: Requires a reachable Amazon Neptune Database endpoint that supports TCP Bolt and openCypher.
Neptune Analytics is intentionally outside this package's scope.
